newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - July 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - July 28.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Japan studied countermeasures to help the United States if military confrontation broke out during 1996 missile crisis in Taiwan strait.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - U.S. to grant transit visa to President Lee Teng-hui with certain restriction.
LIBERTY TIMES - Taiwan may announce to close its unofficial trade office in Cambodia.
Chu Che-chuan, Taiwan's representative in Cambodia, returns to Taiwan.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Nationalist Party enters venture capital business.
Economics Minister Wang Chih-kang says lawmaker Vincent Siew is almost certain to lead new cabinet.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - United Microelectronics chairman Robert Tsao says only two or three 12-inch wafer fabs can survive in 2000.
Grand Petrochemical ordered to close following explosion.
